content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessing script for the FUNWAVE-TVD beach_2d simple case: snapshot surface-elevation plots. Grid setup identical to plot_current.m (fdir='../input_files/output/' @L2, size from eta_00001 @L4-L6, dx=dy=2.0 L7-L8, coordinates L9-L10, sponge outline L12-L13, wavemaker outline L14-L15). Plots two snapshots nfile=[10 50] @L18 with time labels min={'20' '100'} @L19 in a 8x5-inch figure (L21-L23): for each, loads eta_ and mask_ files (L30-L31), NaN-masks dry cells @L33, subplot(1,2,num) @L35, pcolor of eta with caxis([-0.5 2]) (L37-L39), title 'Time = ... sec' @L40, sponge (green dashed @L43) and wavemaker (red @L47) outlines with rotated white text labels (L44-L49), ylabel only on first panel (L51-L53), xlabel @L55, colorbar commented (L56-L57), renderer forced to zbuffer @L59; print commented @L62.
entities: script; clear all @L1; variables: fdir @L2; eta @L4/@L30; n,m @L6; dx @L7; dy @L8; x @L9; y @L10; x_sponge @L12; y_sponge @L13; x_wavemaker @L14; y_wavemaker @L15; nfile @L18; min @L19; wid @L21; len @L22; num @L27; fnum @L29; mask @L31; h1 @L44; h2 @L48
calls: builtins: load, size, sprintf, set/gcf/clf, subplot, pcolor/shading/caxis, title, plot, text, xlabel/ylabel, set(gcf,'Renderer','zbuffer') @L59
unresolved: Time labels '20'/'100' sec @L19 vs file numbers 10/50 @L18 imply a 2 s output interval — consistency with the case's input.txt PLOT_INTV is assumed, not checked; 'min' shadows the builtin and the label says sec while the commented variant calls it minutes
Commented print name @L62 references the inlet_shoal case (copied template); the zbuffer renderer @L59 is removed in newer MATLAB versions
